name: EI Power Berhad
overview: EI Power Berhad 于2026年5月在ACE Market上市，首次公开募股发行129,500,000股新股。年内，公司通过全资子公司EI Power Technologies Sdn. Bhd.以1720万令吉收购位于Shah Alam的永久业权土地及两层半半独立式工厂，以扩大运营基地。此外，公司更改财政年度结束日。
overview_en: EI Power Berhad was listed on the ACE Market in May 2026, with an initial public offering of 129,500,000 new shares. During the year, the company, through its wholly-owned subsidiary EI Power Technologies Sdn. Bhd., acquired a freehold land and a two-and-a-half storey semi-detached factory in Shah Alam for RM17.2 million to expand its operational base. In addition, the company changed its financial year end.
